This game is a simple-sounding motion-sensing cooperative casual puzzle game. It is suitable for users aged 8 and above. It is recommended that minors use the game product under the supervision of their guardians.

This game uses the camera for body-sensing control of the mechanisms. You can complete the dessert-making process by transporting the ingredients to the designated target. It supports 1-4 players to play cooperatively. Once you clear a level, you can unlock new levels.

In accordance with the requirements of the "Notice on Preventing Minors from Being Addicted to Online Games" and the "Notice on Further Strictly Managing and Effectively Preventing Minors from Being Addicted to Online Games" issued by the National Press and Publication Administration, this game has a user real-name authentication system. Users who have not completed real-name authentication are not allowed to play the game. Users who have been authenticated as minors will be subject to the following management: Based on the actual situation of this game, users under the age of 8 are prohibited from playing. Users aged 8 and above are only allowed to play on Fridays, Saturdays, Sundays, and during the 20:00 to 21:00 period on legal holidays. The game duration shall not exceed 1 hour. This game adopts a subscription model. Users can play by purchasing a membership on the platform. Users under the age of 18 are not allowed to make payments.

This game is centered around dessert making as its core theme. The body-sensing operations in the game are beneficial for enhancing players' physical coordination and reaction abilities. The multiplayer cooperative gameplay helps improve players' communication and expression skills as well as their team collaboration awareness. The progressive level design can cultivate players' observation, judgment, and problem-solving abilities. The game features 2D cartoon-like Q-version cute and refreshing graphics and a relaxing, soft original soundtrack, creating a warm and soothing gaming atmosphere. It is particularly suitable for families with children to enjoy together.
